why: The case that protects real people. Every line of an ordinary resume is the person's own record, so every label is 'record'. Each false positive here deletes a genuine line of someone's history before extraction ever sees it, which is worse than a missed injection - that asymmetry is why the prompt resolves ambiguity toward 'record'.
